claims.gist: 60% of large organizations will have a formal AI governance function by 2027
Fewer than one in five large organizations have a formal AI governance function today
Volunteer governance working groups struggle to keep pace with AI use cases
Governance needs an owner, a budget and authority to say no
Regulation, board attention and operational incidents are driving the shift
Organizations without governance will have to explain the gap to regulators and customers
Prediction rests on a survey of 1,200 leaders and 300 client inquiries

thesis: Firm predicts 60% of large organizations will formalize AI governance by 2027, driven by regulation, boards and incidents.
